facts.fact: BBC reported on 2026-07-16 that all Ghanaian businesses and institutions must now check the Ghana Card with the NIA's biometric app scanner instead of photocopying or visual inspection, on pain of fines up to GH¢24,000 for organisations.
BBC reported on 2026-07-16 that the Ghana Card is needed for banking services, SIM card registration, and passport and driver's licence applications.

note: No figure for verifications made, so no usage fact.
